label: speaker_identification-example
grammar:
root ::= ws value
value-speakers-item-label ::= nonempty
value-speakers-item-name-0 ::= nonempty
value-speakers-item-name-1 ::= "null" ws
value-speakers-item-name ::= value-speakers-item-name-0 | value-speakers-item-name-1
value-speakers-item ::= "{" ws "\"label\"" ws ":" ws value-speakers-item-label "," ws "\"name\"" ws ":" ws value-speakers-item-name "}" ws
value-speakers ::= "[" ws value-speakers-item ("," ws value-speakers-item)* "]" ws
value ::= "{" ws "\"speakers\"" ws ":" ws value-speakers "}" ws
string ::= "\"" char* "\"" ws
nonempty ::= "\"" char+ "\"" ws
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F\x7F] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" hex hex hex hex)
hex ::= [0-9a-fA-F]
ws ::= [ \t\r\n]*

messages.content: Identify names for diarized labels from the supplied meeting. Return {"speakers":[{"label":"...","name":"..."}]}. Use null when the identity has no evidence. Return JSON only.

Firnloop Labs planning call. Speaker 1: I am Mina Vale. The harbor sensor trial needs one more battery test. Speaker 2: I am Oren Talo. I will test the battery on Thursday. Speaker 1: We will decide whether to begin the trial after the test; we have not approved a start date.
